construction: One fixed local lossy joint recoding, not a sweep. Per-head uncentered target value-response PCA, project both V and O to rank32. Original target MLP hidden-response PCA to rank768, encode affine up weights into that neuronal frame, retain standard width3072 with inactive zero rows. Sequentially fit each of three down projections once to original full-block responses on the current candidate inputs. No gradients, optimizer, extra training epochs or future partner access. Closed-form calibration fitting is explicitly used.
data: Reuse first256 target-only profile selection training images without labels for construction. Profile confirmation2048 is disjoint from these images but historically inspected. Official MNIST test10000 was also previously inspected; it is calibration-external, not a new unseen research test. No test or confirmation selection of rank, layer, ridge or sign.
screen: Evaluate original, actual compiled release, and oracle-frame anchor completion on confirmation and full target test. Complete public reset of precisely the edited V/O/up/down support must map original and release to identical states; the existing fusion floor is conditional on these fixed sites. No future partners are loaded in this screen. Oracle completion uses defender frames and is labelled privileged, not a public attack.
gate: No automatic accuracy cutoff. Report utility and information-loss diagnostics first; stop this fixed construction if task computation cannot be preserved. Only a plausible utility result advances to separately frozen real fusion, author AGA, public replacement and bounded functional recovery with matched original controls. No novelty, irreversibility-of-model or defense claim follows from matrix rank reduction alone.
